verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for an AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Copilot's own source code is published or openly licensed. The community licensing discussions concern training data and generated suggestions, not Copilot's source, so they do not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
